info.title: Dynamic Timetable API
info.description: Role-based dynamic timetable monitoring system. All endpoints are under /api/v1.

patch.description: Only the caller's own preferences. Primary selection is NOT changed here (see make-primary).

put.description: Remember an archive selection in one domain. Does not change any primary.

get.description: Primary + current selection for one domain. Never returns the other domain's data.
Everything an Admin needs before activation (prompt §9); owners get the same for personal uploads.
Original file, streamed only after the same domain/ownership checks (no public URLs).

post.description: Re-run master-data mapping (after adding rooms/aliases) without re-parsing the file.

get.description: Processing-job monitor: own jobs for everyone; all institutional jobs for Admins (never others' personal jobs).

post.description: Natural-language or structured search. Clients must branch on `status`, never on `message`.
Saves only the question (text and/or intent + typed parameters) — never a domain, timetable or user.

get.description: Role-aware home. Every schedule card uses the same engine handlers as the equivalent typed question.
Students with an open placement, filterable by batch / academic year (promotion candidates).

timetable_id.title: Timetable Id
timetable_id.description: null clears the remembered archive (use primary)
